parameters.content:
## Alert WhatsApp Auto-Send

Sub-workflow invocado por **Alert Scheduler** (`Send Alert WhatsApp` node) cuando una `alert_rules` con `auto_send_sms = true` y `whatsapp_template_id` no nulo genera una nueva `alert_instances`.

Reutiliza el mismo motor de envío que `Whats App.json` (`POST /patients/send_whatsapp_template`): resuelve el template por `entity_type`, valida contra YCloud, envía named-parameters y registra `alert_actions`.

**En envío exitoso** registra un `alert_actions` `SEND_WHATSAPP` / `SUCCESS` y marca la `alert_instances` como `COMPLETED` (`completed_at` = now, `completed_by` = actor), de modo que desaparece del panel de alertas del usuario (el frontend sólo consulta `status = 'PENDING'`). El UPDATE lleva `AND status = 'PENDING'` para no pisar una alerta que el staff ya haya accionado.

**Actor (`performed_by` / `completed_by`)**: es una acción del sistema, no de un usuario, así que se inserta `NULL` (se guarda el uuid solo si el scheduler llega a pasar `performed_by`). Requiere que `alert_actions.performed_by` sea NULLABLE — ver migración del backend `2026xx_alert_actions_performed_by_nullable`. `alert_instances.completed_by` ya es nullable.

**Si algo falla** (paciente sin teléfono, template no aprobado, cita/factura no encontrada, `entity_type` no soportado, YCloud rechaza, etc.) **no lanza error** — registra un `alert_actions` con `result_status = 'FAILED'`, **deja la instancia en `PENDING`** (para que el staff la resuelva a mano) y devuelve `{ success: false }`, para no interrumpir el loop del scheduler.

**Inputs**: `alert_instance_id`, `rule_id`, `patient_id`, `reference_table`, `reference_id`, `whatsapp_template_id` (FK numérico a `communication_templates.id`), `performed_by` (uuid del actor; opcional — si no viene, el workflow hace fallback al usuario `__system__` / `system@invokeia.com`).

**Import checklist**: después de importar este workflow en n8n, copiar su `workflowId` real al node `Send Alert WhatsApp` de `Alert Scheduler`.

parameters.query:
SELECT code, provider_language, entity_type, variables_schema
FROM communication_templates
WHERE id = $1::bigint
  AND type = 'WHATSAPP'
  AND is_active = true
LIMIT 1;

SELECT id::text AS id, name, phone_number, email
FROM users
WHERE id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  a.id::text AS id,
  a.start_datetime,
  a.patient_id::text AS patient_id,
  u.name AS professional_name
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.assignee_id
WHERE a.id::text = $1
  AND a.patient_id = $2::uuid
LIMIT 1;

return [{ json: { success: false, skipped: true, reason: 'test_mode_not_whitelisted', alert_instance_id: trigger.alert_instance_id || null } }];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.alert_actions
  (alert_instance_id, action_type, action_data, result_status, result_message, performed_by, performed_at)
VALUES (
  $1::int, 'SEND_WHATSAPP', $2::jsonb, 'SUCCESS', $3,
  NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid,
  now()
)
RETURNING alert_instance_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.alert_instance_id, JSON.stringify({ message_id: $json.message_id || null, ycloud_status: $json.ycloud_status || null, phone: $json.phone || null, template: $json.meta_template_name || null }), 'WhatsApp enviado automáticamente (' + ($json.ycloud_status || 'sent') + ')', ($('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.performed_by || '') ] }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.alert_instances
SET status = 'COMPLETED',
    completed_at = now(),
    completed_by = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int
  AND status = 'PENDING'
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.alert_instance_id, ($('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.performed_by || '') ] }}

INSERT INTO public.alert_actions
  (alert_instance_id, action_type, action_data, result_status, result_message, performed_by, performed_at)
VALUES (
  $1::int, 'SEND_WHATSAPP', '{}'::jsonb, 'FAILED', $2,
  NULLIF($3::text, '')::uuid,
  now()
)
RETURNING alert_instance_id, result_message;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.alert_instance_id, ($json.result_message || $json.message || 'Fallo en el auto-envío de WhatsApp'), ($('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.performed_by || '') ] }}
